answer: Make each agent sign its work with a hardware-bound key that must stay online, answering surprise latency probes from scattered peers. One server pretending to be fifty agents can't reply to fifty probes at once without fifty real machines, so cost scales with clones and can't be shared. Fakes crumble like sandstone while honest nodes hold like basalt; a single quill of signatures can't fake fifty, and spoofed timings scatter like a zephyr.
